note: Floorplan of the battery demo board: the outline is the floorplanner's to choose. USB-C on the top edge, the battery connector on the bottom edge, both facing out. The RP2350 core regulator is the package's generated qfn60-4layer layout, moved as one. Separations come from the packages' rules: the IMU 10 mm from the USB-C receptacle (a force point) and 5 mm from the heat of the charger and the buck (lsm6dso rules); the buck's switch node 5 mm from the crystal (library crystal.routing.keepout).

separations.note: crystal.routing.keepout: no switching nodes near the crystal
